text:
alex: Quick sync — proposing header-based client gating in the JS/TS SDK so we can toggle features without a client release. Details below.

alex: Proposal: add X-Redwood-Flags header with semicolon-separated flags + client_version; SDK sets header automatically from package.json (semver).

alex: Example header:
```
X-Redwood-Flags: new_routing=on;beta_proto=off;client_version=1.5.0
```

priya: 👍 This helps canaries. Q: how do we fallback for older clients that don't send header?

jon: For older clients treat missing header as client_version=0 and route to stable path. Server-side allowlist for specific canary user ids (email hash / account id) is safest.

maya: Rollout guardrails suggestion: start with internal-only, then cohort sizes 1% -> 5% -> 25%. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate increase +3% absolute or latency p50 delta >100ms for 5m window. Also require at least 2 successful canary runs before broader ramp.

alex: SDK API idea: expose runtime opt-in override for devs: `Redwood.client.setFeature('new_routing', true)` that updates header for local testing. Defaults remain server-driven.

lucy: Need to add a client_version check so SDK doesn't advertise flags unsupported by server. Also log telemetry event when a runtime override is used (opt-in telemetry only).

ci-bot: CI reminder: add unit tests for header serialization/parsing + e2e test against canary env.

priya: I’ll draft the RFC + PR this afternoon. Checklist I have: header format RFC, SDK change (JS/TS), server parsing + fallback, rollout plan with metrics, canary cohort script, UA tests. Anything missing?

jon: Add CHANGELOG entry and migration note for integrators. I'll review the PR.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC to cohort=internal-beta (2.4% traffic).

alex: Perfect. Priya — ping here with the PR link and I'll nudge for review. Thanks all.
